title: Nick Huber - Sweaty Startup - Videos
description:
I’m Nick Huber. I sold a service business for 7 figures and now operate 1.9M sq ft of self-storage with 44 employees. I talk about real estate, entrepreneurship, and building simple, profitable businesses.

This is where I share what’s working, straight talk on hiring, leverage, operations, and wealth. 
I also send a weekly email to 230K+ people:  https://sweatystartup.ck.page 

Here are the links to my businesses:
Business Brokerage - https://nickhuber.com/
Personal Brand - https://sweatystartup.com/
